title: Does the endpoint count?
heading: Does the endpoint count?
description: The guessing game allows 100 as well as smaller numbers. This question uses <, so what does it say about 100? Run, then change < to <= and compare 99, 100 and 101.

scene.label: Python output for the number guessing game.

feedback.success: <= includes equality. For the lower endpoint, try guess >= 1 with 0, 1 and 2. != means “not equal”: try guess != 42. Checking the full 1–100 range will need both endpoint checks.
